messages:
Priya Narang: Heads-up team — NimbusTech QBR next Thurs, 20min with SVP Product. Need: 1-slide exec asks, short onboarding gate list, renewal health, and owners. Drive: https://tiny.redwood/nimbus-qbr

Zoe Kim: I'll pull 30d seat activation & latency percentiles. Will paste into slide 3.

Marco Silva: Renewal signal = amber. Main issues: low seat activation, missing analytics export, one critical SSO claim mismatch. Suggest ask for temporary usage credits + prioritized analytics access.

Lina Gomez: I can run a 4-day unblock sprint focused on claim mapping + demo refresh. Need approval for 6 SE-hours.

Priya Narang: Draft exec asks in doc (slide 1): approve 4-week pilot + credits, prioritize analytics export, allocate SE hours for unblock. Everyone add a one-line ask by EOD.

Rajiv Menon: Invites sent. I'll make a single-line "decision needed" slide: pilot yes/no + budget for enablement.

ops-bot: Reminder set: final deck review meeting on 2025-04-09 16:00.

Zoe Kim: Added engagement funnel and a small table with 30/60 retention projections. Notable: 22% drop after week 1.

Marco Silva: SSO ticket assigned to Nimbus infra, ETA Wed EOD. Analytics export on the product backlog; escalation in progress.

Lina Gomez: I'll post the enablement runbook and templates by Tue noon.

Priya Narang: Action items (copying here):

```
- Lina: unblock sprint plan + runbook (due Tue noon)
- Zoe: data slides (due Wed EOD)
- Marco: SSO + analytics status (due Wed 5pm)
- Rajiv: exec slide + invite confirmation (done)
- Priya: collect customer quote and finalize asks (due Thu)
```

Rajiv Menon: Added my one-line ask: "Approve pilot extension + enablement hours to prove retention lift."

Priya Narang: Thanks — dry run Wed 09:00 (10m). I'll circulate runbook and speaking order.

Lina Gomez: Will be ready to present the unblock plan.

Zoe Kim: :thumbsup:
